entries.label: Cyborg lourd / Berserker — Metal Gear Rising
entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE complete isolated static raster asset of the HEAVILY ARMED CYBORG / BERSERKER from Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance (2013), using these three actual-game screenshots. Image 1 defines his face mask, large collar and front armor; image 2 shows the complete leg and foot silhouette; image 3 confirms his side shape and the whole heavy industrial hammer. Preserve the very bulky original gray metallic cyborg design: small bald scalp above a dark armored face mask, enormous rigid open oval/rectangular protective collar around the head, heavy gray central chest shell, dark ribbed mechanical shoulders and upper arms, metallic forearm guards and gloved hands, broad angular thigh panels with the source's modest red markings, thick black flexible joint sections, long shaped shin armor and black mechanical feet. Match the original game materials, plate proportions, gray-black colors and small red accents. He holds the ONE original large red-and-gray industrial hammer horizontally/diagonally in both hands at a lowered resting-ready position; preserve its long rectangular shaft and heavy rectangular/faceted mechanical head exactly as shown, no glowing energy effect. Use a balanced whole-body standing posture with slight knee bend and a three-quarter turn facing screen-right. Both feet and every part of the hammer, including the head and handle end, must stay fully inside the frame. Render the actual game character with clear crisp raster edges and restrained material detail, no redesigned armor, no cape, no extra weapons, no new insignia and no generic science-fiction suit. Do not include the silver-haired character in image 3, the rooftop, buildings, sparks, flames, distortion, smoke or interface. One character with his one original tool/weapon only, entire scalp-to-soles figure occupying about 85 percent of a portrait or near-square canvas with safe transparent margins. True transparent RGBA alpha; no floor, base, shadow, gradient, halo, matte, checkerboard pixels, captions, labels, panels or second pose. Static source-guided CQC adaptation for fidelity review, not a certified extracted model.
entries.correctionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve this exact single Berserker cyborg character and his hammer, with the same design, materials, colors, face mask, collar, proportions, stance and transparent alpha. Make ONLY a framing correction: zoom out the entire existing subject enough to add at least 8 percent empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides. Restore the tiny outer-left edge of the hammer that currently touches the canvas, preserving its original mechanical shape; do not redesign it. Every part of the scalp, collar, shoulders, hammer head, hammer shaft tip and both feet must be entirely inside the canvas with clear separation from its edges. Keep everything else unchanged. No new body parts or items. True transparent RGBA background, no shadow, backdrop, glow, text or labels.
entries.restoredFrom: Exact built-in tool dataURL; first local output failed while disk was full. The PNG bytes were preserved in a GitHub blob before restoring this path.

notes: Collerette massive, masque, armure grise/noire à détails rouges et marteau comparés à trois captures du jeu.
Premier essai conservé comme rejeté: bord gauche du marteau au contact du canevas. Correction de cadrage sélectionnée avec marges transparentes.
Pas de certification 1:1; les surfaces cachées et la précision de chaque plaque restent à revoir.

entries.label: Trenya — apparition Monster Hunter dans Peace Walker
entries.episode: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (2010), crossover Monster Hunter
entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE isolated complete full-body raster sprite of TRENYA, the Felyne boatman who appears in the Monster Hunter crossover briefing cutscene in METAL GEAR SOLID: PEACE WALKER (2010). The three supplied framesheets are from that actual game's illustrated cutscene: use the full-body cat standing in the boat in image 1 and image 3 for proportions and equipment, and the clear frontal close views in image 2 for face, goggles and helmet. Preserve the small bipedal gray tabby cat's authentic proportions, cream muzzle and chest tuft, striped gray forearms and hind legs, pointed ears, whiskers and cat paws. His characteristic bright warm-yellow rounded expedition helmet has a dark horizontal black opening/band on its front and a small dark crown detail, with compact round dark-lensed silver-rim goggles across the lower forehead/eyes, as actually illustrated. Preserve the large worn dark gray-brown expedition backpack rising above his shoulders with rolled cloth and wooden pole/equipment ends, the harness straps across his torso, and the loose shorts/waist gear and bare furry cat hind paws seen in the distant standing reference. Do not turn him into a human, a different Palico armor, a modern mascot or a new fantasy adventurer. Keep the characteristic Peace Walker inked hand-painted cutscene style, muted graphite gray and brown fur/equipment with the yellow helmet as the main color accent, clear outline and natural small feline body. Depict him in a quiet standing three-quarter pose facing screen-right, both forepaws relaxed and visible, knees naturally slightly bent, head looking to the right, the full pack visible behind his shoulders. No paddle or boat, no Snake, no other character. Do not invent shiny armor, boots, weapons, insignia, or extra accessories. One character only, entire helmet and backpack tips down to both hind paws inside frame with at least 8 percent clear margins. Transparent RGBA alpha background with no water, floor, shadows, paper texture, speech bubble, UI, title, logo, writing, panels, aura, matte or checkerboard pixels. This is a source-guided static adaptation pending fidelity review; the tiny or occluded parts should remain restrained and simple rather than newly embellished.

notes: Casque jaune à fente noire, lunettes, sac volumineux, pelage tabby gris et dessin encré comparés à la cinématique illustrée du jeu.
Le corps entier est attesté à distance dans la barque; les surfaces cachées du sac et le petit détail des vêtements restent à revoir.
Apparition crossover officielle du jeu; aucune assimilation à la chronologie principale n'est revendiquée.

rejected.reason: Left hammer edge touches canvas; replaced by complete framing correction.

unresolved.label: Custom cyborg — épéiste blindé MGR
unresolved.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create exactly ONE whole-body isolated raster sprite of the CUSTOM CYBORG enemy from METAL GEAR RISING: REVENGEANCE (2013), precisely following the supplied actual-game screenshot. This is the larger armored swordsman on the rooftop, distinct from the standard Desperado soldier and the huge hammer Berserker. Preserve his large muscular cyborg build, bald skin-colored crown at top of head, dark full-face armored mask, black neck/collar frame, dark charcoal armored upper torso with layered chest/abdominal plates, pale silver-gray segmented upper-arm/forearm armor, black gloved hands, thick segmented gray thigh armor, rounded knee guards, pointed overlapping lower-leg armor, black mechanical split-toe feet, and all the visible characteristic plate shapes and dark flexible gaps. Keep his restrained black/gray/silver palette as in the game, not a new colored power suit. Carry ONE complete very long straight dark high-frequency sword with its simple long grip, both hands on the handle, blade angled upward toward screen-right. The blade must remain completely within frame from pommel to point. One whole character only in a stable broad three-quarter fighting-ready stance facing SCREEN-RIGHT, with nose/mask direction and both toes oriented to the right. Both feet, scalp and fingers completely visible. Reproduce realistic original 2013 game-model material textures with clean readable raster edges, modest painted refinement, not photorealistic human clothing, not futuristic redesign. No generic modern soldier pouches, guns, helmet covering the bald crown, cape, electrical glow, extra blades, effects or enemy characters. The entire character and long sword fit inside a tall transparent canvas with generous headroom and safe margins. Genuine RGBA transparency, no rooftop, skyline, ground, floor shadow, color matte, halo, checkerboard pixels, text, logo, caption, UI or sprite-sheet grid. Source-guided static adaptation pending external review; the source screenshot is the design authority.
unresolved.notes: No image returned. The failed request was not repeated or rephrased to evade the block.
